integrity: The transfer-current formula, five disjoint edge classes, sharp row sums, and degree-four comparison are established in RESULT.md; checker.py independently reconstructs selected rows using exact grounded Laplacian solves. No claim of independent mathematical or bibliographic verification is made.
scientific_limitations: Exact claims apply only to finite nontrivial symmetric 2-design incidence graphs with unweighted Euclidean edge projection and induced coordinate maximum norm. The analytic proof covers all such designs; finite rational checking covers nine examples only. A historical expert audit could identify equivalent prior electrical-network formulas.
title: Exact max-norm Hodge stability on symmetric block-design incidence graphs
